required_before_session: owner's go per spec/07 camera-run procedure

design.scene_weights: equal scene weight; equal start weight within each scene

combinations.fixture: static textured intended plane with fixed low illumination
static textured intended plane with fixed low illumination
intended foreground target with distracting textured background; hunting is an observation, not an assumed behavior
intended foreground target with distracting textured background; hunting is an observation, not an assumed behavior

randomization.blocks: one complete combination block per repeat; count from design.repeats_per_combination
randomization.sort_key: SHA256 ASCII(seed + | + two-digit repeat + | + combination_id), ascending hex; tie by combination_id
randomization.future_controller_order: ascending SHA256 ASCII(seed + | + pair_id + | + controller); tie by controller
randomization.replacement_policy: keep original; any replacement gets a new attempt ID and reason

timing.clock: declared camera acquisition/event clocks; optional video clock with synchronization uncertainty
timing.start_event: source-bound AF request when established; otherwise declared visible half-press proxy
timing.confirmation_event: declared camera confirmation event; internal result and visible indication reported separately
timing.acceptable_focus_onset: null unless independently validated continuous ROI/plane observations bound onset
timing.default_report: confirmation latency and independently verified final quality
timing.uncertainty: source clock resolution, acquisition intervals and synchronization/visibility bounds; unknown remains null
timing.fallback: stock-only pilot has no candidate fallback; future fallback counts from original start under same deadline

quality.domain: declared coherent image domain with fixed processing and intended target ROI/plane; preview is not saved-photo quality
quality.metric: independently validated intended-region sharpness and plane correctness; same-scene reference normalization
quality.reference: bounded validated stock lens-control sweep at fixed geometry/settings; both approach directions and repeated best-region captures
quality.freeze_rule: calibrate independent metric and wrong-plane check before timed acquisitions; threshold and repeatability cannot be selected from controller outcomes

attempt_policy.all_attempt_metric: mean deadline-capped independent acquisition time if observable; otherwise failure fraction and mean deadline-capped confirmation proxy, explicitly labelled
attempt_policy.invalid_policy: retain protocol-error/cancelled attempts and reasons; include deadline penalty in conservative all-attempt result; separate valid-only sensitivity
attempt_policy.censoring: unobserved focus onset is missing, not zero or confirmation; deadline-crossing observed intervals are right-censored
attempt_policy.exclusions: no silent removal; frozen reasons applied equally to controllers

split_policy.held_out_rule: entire new scenes and sessions, including reference sweeps, remain unavailable to candidate tuning; no adjacent-frame split
split_policy.pilot_use: measurement calibration, fixture revision, variance and sample-size planning only
confirmation_freeze: positive accuracy endpoint, minimum effect and confidence rule

analysis.pilot_decision: descriptive readiness and large regressions only; no acceptance gate or target forecast
analysis.latency: per-combination and weighted aggregate median; descriptive p95 with explicit small-sample limitation
analysis.uncertainty: carry event intervals; cluster by scene/session, preserve paired attempts; do not treat all repeats as independent scenes
analysis.confirmatory_method: freeze hierarchical paired resampling and interval sensitivity before confirmation; insufficient clusters or narrow-margin power means inconclusive
analysis.target_policy: specification choices, revisable before confirmation; confidence bounds support speed and noninferiority, and a separate frozen positive accuracy endpoint is required to claim more accurate AF
